# Kirian Caumes

> Kirian Caumes is a Lead Tech and Full Stack Developer based near Nantes, France. He designs and builds custom, high-performance business web applications, specializing in TypeScript, React and Node.js/NestJS, and works across the full software lifecycle from functional scoping to production deployment.

## About

- Full name: Kirian Caumes
- Role: Lead Tech / Développeur Full Stack
- Location: Nantes area, France
- Born: 1997
- Languages: French (native), English (professional working proficiency)
- Employer: Next Decision (since June 2018; Lead Tech since September 2021)

## Expertise

- Software architecture and full stack web development
- TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Node.js, NestJS, Fastify
- REST APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger), PostgreSQL, MongoDB, ElasticSearch
- Cloud Azure (AKS), Docker, CI/CD, Linux
- Accessibility (WCAG), SEO and Core Web Vitals
- Technical leadership: architecture decisions, client scoping workshops, mentoring of junior developers, software quality standards
- AI-assisted development: generative AI integrated across the delivery chain (specification, code, review, acceptance testing, migrations) with Claude Code, agents and MCP; author of a Claude Code project toolkit (agent instructions, code review, acceptance, RGAA audit and migration skills, Azure DevOps integration) reused on new agency projects; Azure OpenAI agents (n8n) for CV parsing and search in client applications

## Projects

- Emptio: marketplace aggregator PWA, scraping 20+ platforms, price tracking, push notifications, WebAuthn (https://github.com/KirianCaumes/Emptio)
- In Flames Bootlegs: searchable archive of live recordings (https://in-flames-bootlegs.kiriancaumes.fr)
- Discogs Marketplace API: open source TypeScript client published on npm (https://github.com/KirianCaumes/Discogs-Marketplace-API-NodeJS)
- FFHB Championship Calendar Generator: synchronizable calendars for amateur handball (https://ffhb-champ-calendar-generator.kiriancaumes.fr)
